title: Sforza informer at Sarzana, seven cipher letters on Ludovico Sforza, Tomasino Campofregoso and Corsica (ASMi cart. 1598)

steps.what: DECODE PDFs of cart. 1598 fetched with the cookie (targets/sforza1598).
Letters of cart. 1598 grouped by sign hand; family B = R5562, R5572, R5573, R5575-R5577, R5586.
CTTS on R5562 alone: 24.09 M vs 10.73 M shuffled; two seeds agree; continuous Italian.
Key applied unchanged to the six other letters: 4+ letter word cover 0.54-0.67 vs 0.10-0.17 shuffled.
5-gram re-scoring flagged 130 positions; two look-alike merges (underlined rr4 = o vs r4 = m; S = h vs 5 = v) confirmed on image crops; 38 fixes accepted, 5 dropped.
o-with-cross, 6 and 10 identified as nulls between doubled letters (messo, Volterra, disse, podesse).
Names checked against reference works (Ludovico Sforza at Pisa 1477-79, Bona of Savoy regency, Tommasino Campofregoso of Sarzana, Milanese Corsica to 1481, Nicodemo Tranchedini at Genoa 1478, DBI).

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 4324 tokens, 32 types, it-cinquecento order 4: reading -2.252 per letter; random keys -4.198 (z 6.7); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -3.122 (mean -3.134, z 93.0); annealer on the real text -2.252. Verdict: pass.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.252; polyphony 0.0; 0 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -2.252

outcome.method_basis: The key was annealed from R5562 alone and then read the six other letters unchanged.
outcome.fraction_read_source: decryption_*.txt: letters inside dictionary words, names or function words (strict segmenter; chancery spellings count as unread)

texts.label: R5562, cart. 1598 no. 88, 5 December

reading_review.by: Claude (model); review by Brice Dudout requested
reading_review.note: Coherent sentences with a few open words per letter; R5586 second half damaged.

texts.summary: The writer reports on a stay in Florence: Iovan Galeasmo was there seeking arrangements with the Florentines, with a man of the archbishop's; he warns that any deal with messer Ludovico should be guaranteed through Tomasino, who means to settle Corsican affairs, and mentions a Venetian envoy going to Florence and Rome.

texts.label: R5572, cart. 1598 no. 98, 13 March

reading_review.by: Claude (model); review by Brice Dudout requested
reading_review.note: Coherent sentences with a few open words per letter; R5586 second half damaged.

texts.summary: Messer Ludovico has sent the Sienese Bartolomeo Borella to Siena, hoping to be made governor of Siena by the duchess, working through Piero de Cosmo and others; Tomasino is sending one Marcelino to raise the Corsicans, but would settle with Madonna on honest terms.

texts.label: R5573, cart. 1598 no. 99, 23 March

reading_review.by: Claude (model); review by Brice Dudout requested
reading_review.note: Coherent sentences with a few open words per letter; R5586 second half damaged.

texts.summary: Tomasino's messenger is back from Corsica and found things quiet, but Tomasino is thinking of moving for his own advantage; the writer will come to Milan after Easter.

texts.label: R5575, cart. 1598 no. 101, 20 February

reading_review.by: Claude (model); review by Brice Dudout requested
reading_review.note: Coherent sentences with a few open words per letter; R5586 second half damaged.

texts.summary: Nicodemo has encouraged messer Ludovico, whose suspicions of his own people led the writer to take the chancellorship of Volterra as cover; he passes on Iovan Galeaso's news of a letter from Iovan Coscia and an envoy, Piero del Cerreto, a man of the archbishop's.

texts.label: R5576, cart. 1598 no. 102, 7 June

reading_review.by: Claude (model); review by Brice Dudout requested
reading_review.note: Coherent sentences with a few open words per letter; R5586 second half damaged.

texts.summary: Messer Ludovico weighs a place on the ducal council; a relative from Florence reports that count Guido Rangone is to come, sent by the duke of Modena, and the writer suspects a plot.

texts.label: R5577, cart. 1598 no. 103, 17 July

reading_review.by: Claude (model); review by Brice Dudout requested
reading_review.note: Coherent sentences with a few open words per letter; R5586 second half damaged.

texts.summary: Messer Ludovico and Tomasino are at odds and their distrust grows; the writer's courier route through Ponsano has failed, he will go to Volterra in September, and he asks the duchess and duke for forty ducats.

texts.label: R5586, cart. 1598 no. 112, 8 February

reading_review.by: Claude (model); review by Brice Dudout requested
reading_review.note: Coherent sentences with a few open words per letter; R5586 second half damaged.

texts.summary: From Florence: no Florentine dealings on Ludovico's behalf that he knows of; he has urged Ludovico to leave Florentine lands and believes neither the Florentines nor the duke of Modena will act without the duke's consent; Iovan Galeaso seeks Ludovico's leave through him.
